text:
First, convert 28 weeks and 6 days to days:  
28 weeks × 7 days/week = 196 days  
196 + 6 = 202 days to subtract.

Start date: 1348-01-08 (assuming format is DD-MM-YYYY, so 08-01-1348 → 1348-01-08).  
Subtract 202 days:  
January has 31 days, so go back to 1347-12-31 after 8 days (202 days total to subtract).  

Step:  
202 − 8 = 194 days left after reaching 1347-12-31.  
December 1347 has 31 days, November 30, October 31, September 30, August 31, July 31, June 30, May 31, April 30, March 31, February 28 (1347 not leap year), January 31.  

Count backward:  
From 1347-12-31:  
December: 0 (already at Dec 31)  
November: 30 days → 194 − 30 = 164 left  
October: 31 → 164 − 31 = 133  
September: 30 → 133 − 30 = 103  
August: 31 → 103 − 31 = 72  
July: 31 → 72 − 31 = 41  
June: 30 → 41 − 30 = 11  
May: 31 → go back 11 days into May: May 31 − 11 days = May 20, 1347.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1347-05-20
